blurb: Guests join tours to learn about beekeeping, honey harvesting, and mead making, including tastings of mead varieties and light snacks. Experiences include guided tours to an apiary and interactive mead tastings. The Wahiawa Honey House offers free honey samples, gifts, and an outdoor mead tasting garden.
